title: Code and data for "Filtered merges make deeper representation trees pay: Subset Sum and Meet-LWE"
description: Model and optimisers, independent re-costers, simulations, the stored best points, and the generators that reproduce every number and table in the paper (IACR ePrint, November 2026). Dubiner's bucketing codes used as type-class filters at the merges of representation trees: random density-one Subset Sum 0.2831 -> 0.2690 (BBSS digits {-1,0,1,2}, depth 5); May's Meet-LWE on ternary keys improved by 0.013-0.023.
